g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-212 Bin screw feeder (built in house, 9 off) · rev B
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: ELEVATION (from the ring centre side, looking at the feeder)

g.text: INLET FLANGE 200 sq x 6, 4 x Ø11 on 160 sq
= bin outlet flange; gasket P1-212-501, 4 x M10 (H1) 25 N·m
TAIL CAP: 2.5 in TC, HEX-NUT CLAMP (tool)
remove to pull the screw out (LOTO first)
sleeve P1-214 to the lid stub
perforated Ø5, no reach to the coupling
centre on R280 of the hopper lid

svg.text: VIEW C: from the drive end
Barrel weldment (tube, transition, inlet flange, end flange, spout, tail ferrule)
Screw (shaft + formed flight), removable from the tail end
TC clamp 2.5 in hex nut + P1-246 gasket
P1-220 (stub 2.5 in x 25 in Ø70 port)
R280 from the hopper axis, on the bin radius
ring legs moved to 15° (P1-210 rev B)
1. Feeder hangs from the bin outlet flange only. Net moment at the flange 26 N·m [19 lbf·ft] (drive end balances the barrel); see calc on P1-212-900.
2. The screw is supported at both ends: drive pin in the socket (x = -93) and the UHMW tail bush. No bearing in the product.
3. Cleaning: LOTO at isolator P1-248, open the tail clamp (tool), pull the screw out of the tail end. The drive end stays put.
4. Rotation: screw is RIGHT HAND; motor turns CW seen from the motor fan end to carry product +x. Check before filling (P1-212-900 T14).
